title: SpecKit autopilot run status
description: Closed status vocabulary for the top-level autopilot-state.json run status. autopilot-state.json is the current-in-flight pointer for one run; the per-spec durable record is the workflow file, which survives archive. Retired spellings that must not reappear: complete, complete_pr_open, completed archived, running.

nesting_mode.description: Complete runner response persisted by resolve-nesting-mode in apply mode. Absent before the nesting preflight; partial hand-written copies are invalid.

stage.description: Mirror of the workflow file's Stage row for the active run only. The workflow file is authoritative; on disagreement it wins and this mirror is repaired from it. Absence means no stage has been resolved yet and is not an error.

execution_control.description: Optional native-orchestrator mirror of the last execution-control result for this workflow. The durable ledger remains authoritative; this visibility record is not permission, completion evidence, or independent proof and never resets counters.

ledger_path.description: Repository-relative lookup hint returned by the helper, not authority to read outside the execution root.

run_id.description: Copied from result.data.ledger.run_id, never minted by a worker or recovered from a stale state mirror.

prior_run_note.description: Verbatim record of the status carried by the predecessor run whose single state slot this run reclaimed. Reclaiming a foreign slot is normal operation, not an error; the note is what separates reclaiming a finished run from one still recorded in_progress.
